vb_textbox.text: I think the number of mushrooms collected was not the same each time for each gnome chosen, however, as a rule I found that those with larger hats collected more mushrooms than those with smaller ones if the choice was between the two. In a choice between red and green, I think that red collected more overall. Between the blue and brown, I think both of these collected a good amount and that in alternate rounds both collected a lot. Pink seemed to collect more than orange. I think a lot of it was just down to the luck of the game, just make sure you choose a gnome or hit space in time!
